title: The AIX root accounts home directory must not have an extended ACL.
check_content:
Verify the "root" account's home directory has no extended ACL using command:

# aclget ~root 
*
* ACL_type   AIXC
*
attributes:
base permissions
    owner(root):  rwx
    group(system):  ---
    others:  ---
extended permissions
    disabled

If extended permissions are enabled, the directory has an extended ACL, and this is a finding.
fixtext:
Remove the extended ACL from the "root" account's home directory using command:
# acledit ~root 

Change extended attributes to disabled.
VulnDiscussion: Excessive permissions on root home directories allow unauthorized access to root user files.
